title: Choose a tarot question and draw your cards.
intro: Browse 62 questions about relationships, career, money, study, projects, and your own direction. Each link opens the card generator with that question ready.
resultContext: The prompt asks your AI tool to answer from the cards first, then give two possible interpretations, something to check, and one small action.
disclaimer: Tarot is for entertainment and self-reflection. Money questions do not predict income, prices, loan or debt outcomes, or investment returns; they do not tell you to buy, sell, or borrow, decide affordability, or replace qualified advice.
